top_signals.title: Capita Dives 74% as CEO Exit Marks UK Outsourcer’s Downfall
top_signals.summary: Capita Plc lost almost three-quarters of its value after the British company parted with its chief executive officer, warned of a fresh hit to profit and moved to issue new equity following growing problems with one of the government’s biggest outsourcing contracts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Wall Street Surges Toward M&A Record as Megadeals Defy Selloff
top_signals.summary: Wall Street is taking a big step toward a record year for mergers and acquisitions as some of the world’s largest companies defy a tech-induced selloff in global stocks to pursue major takeovers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ECB to let banks pledge more tokenized securities as collateral
top_signals.summary: The ECB aims to start accepting securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s distributed ledger pilot program in June 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The biggest money-making energy trade looks over. What to buy instead
top_signals.summary: The epic boom in refinery-related stocks is unwinding.

top_signals.title: Hackers breach Austrian Foreign Ministry website, access diplomats' contact details
top_signals.summary: Austria's Foreign Ministry said late last week that hackers breached one of its websites and accessed the names and official contact information of employees at its Vienna headquarters and at Austria’s diplomatic missions abroad.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Call center operator gets 8 years for helping scam 30,000 Americans
top_signals.summary: A Peruvian call center operator was sentenced to eight years in prison for stealing millions of dollars from over 30,000 Spanish-speaking US residents in a years-long government-impersonation fraud scheme. [...]
